# Centile plots

```{python}
# ============================================================
# CENTILE PLOTS
# Age and Sex for comp2, comp10, comp11
# Save to results/figures
# ============================================================

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from pcntoolkit import (
    NormativeModel,
    NormData,
    plot_centiles
)


# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

current_dir = Path.cwd().parent

model_dir = (
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "normative_model"
    / "BLR"
)

figure_dir = (
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "figures"
)

figure_dir.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)

age_dir = figure_dir / "centiles_age"
sex_dir = figure_dir / "centiles_sex"

age_dir.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)

sex_dir.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)


# ============================================================
# LOAD MODEL
# ============================================================

model = NormativeModel.load(
    str(model_dir)
)

print("BLR model loaded")


# ============================================================
# LOAD MODELLING DATA
# ============================================================

model_df = pd.read_csv(
    current_dir
    / "results"
    / "combined_dataset"
    / "Model_dataframe.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# DEFINE VARIABLES
# ============================================================

response_vars = [
    f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19)
]

selected_responses = [
    "comp2",
    "comp10",
    "comp11"
]

batch_effects = [
    "Dataset_name"
]

covariates = [
    col for col in model_df.columns
    if col not in (
        [
            "Scan_id",
            "Participant_Id",
            "Dataset_name"
        ]
        + response_vars
    )
]


# ============================================================
# CREATE NORMDATA
# ============================================================

norm_data = NormData.from_dataframe(
    name="DigitalRodent",
    dataframe=model_df,
    covariates=covariates,
    batch_effects=batch_effects,
    response_vars=response_vars,
    remove_Nan=False
)


# ============================================================
# AGE CENTILE PLOTS
# ============================================================

age_figures = plot_centiles(
    model,
    scatter_data=norm_data,
    covariate="Age(week)",
    response_vars=selected_responses,
    centiles=[0.05, 0.50, 0.95]
)

for component, fig in zip(
    selected_responses,
    age_figures
):
    ax = fig.axes[0]

    ax.set_xlabel("Age (weeks)")
    ax.set_ylabel("DR value")
    ax.set_title(f"{component} by age")

    fig.tight_layout()

    fig.savefig(
        age_dir / f"{component}_Age.png",
        dpi=300,
        bbox_inches="tight"
    )

    plt.show()
    plt.close(fig)


# ============================================================
# SEX CENTILE PLOTS
# ============================================================

sex_figures = plot_centiles(
    model,
    scatter_data=norm_data,
    covariate="Sex_M",
    response_vars=selected_responses,
    centiles=[0.05, 0.50, 0.95]
)

for component, fig in zip(
    selected_responses,
    sex_figures
):
    ax = fig.axes[0]

    ax.set_xticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_xticklabels([
        "Female",
        "Male"
    ])

    ax.set_xlabel("Sex")
    ax.set_ylabel("DR value")
    ax.set_title(f"{component} by sex")

    fig.tight_layout()

    fig.savefig(
        sex_dir / f"{component}_Sex.png",
        dpi=300,
        bbox_inches="tight"
    )

    plt.show()
    plt.close(fig)
```
